title: removeMetadata
body:
## removeMetadata

Write new copies of photographs (a new copy of the same container) with chosen categories of metadata removed: location (GPS and named places), capture time, device identity, descriptive text, creator and rights, and embedded thumbnails; or, alone, a rendering-preserving minimise for JPEG, PNG and WebP that deletes every EXIF, XMP, IPTC, Photoshop and text block and comment and keeps the encoded image, the rendering chunks or segments and the EXIF orientation, chroma position and colour space. TIFF and DNG minimise, thumbnails outside JPEG and every HEIF removal are named refusals. Native deletions are a closed list derived from the trusted listing of each capture, never authored and never a bare delete-all. Absence is proved by the independent readers and by a fresh native listing, the encoded image and rendering segments are proved byte-identical, and residual.json lists what remains with its limits.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- This is removal of the listed categories in the understood locations, not anonymisation or privacy certification: file names, pixel content, unrecognised maker notes and embedded content remain.
- An unrecognised maker note cannot be removed by ExifTool, so deviceIdentity refuses such a file; XMP structures that cannot be deleted without removing unrelated properties refuse the item.
- Removing rights metadata can remove licence or attribution notices that may be legally required; the choice is yours.
- Orientation, colour space, ICC, JFIF and Adobe segments are never removed, so a rotated photograph stays rotated.
- A kept PNG, WebP or TIFF orientation stays: PNG-3 treats eXIf as a historical value, so a kept Orientation is preserved for viewers that honour it. A maker note and DNGPrivateData are kept and published as residuals.

Native binding: `one perl exiftool -config "" process per item: whole-group deletes (-GPS:all= -IFD1:all= -MakerNotes:all=) and -GROUP:TAG= deletes of keys the trusted listing of the capture reports; minimise: whole-block deletes (-EXIF:all= -XMP:all= -IPTC:all= -Photoshop:all= -File:Comment=), -ExifByteOrder= of the capture and numeric re-assignment of the independently read rendering values (never a bare -all=); -o stage/ID.jpg captured/ID.jpg`. Output kind: `["image","text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | The set of photographs and XMP sidecar files to read: either an explicit list of items or one folder. Every item is captured into the run before any native process starts, and every scanned folder entry is listed in manifest.json as included or excluded with a reason, so you can see exactly which files were and were not examined. | `{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","required":true,"minItems":1,"maxItems":512,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64},"sidecar":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}}}}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"folder":{"type":"object","required":true,"properties":{"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"extensions":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":11,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":[".jpg",".jpeg",".xmp",".tif",".tiff",".dng",".png",".webp",".heic",".heif",".avif"]}},"depth":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":2},"maxItems":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":512},"sidecars":{"type":"enum","values":["none","adjacent"]}}}}}]}` | **required** |
| `categories` | The metadata categories to remove: location, captureTime, deviceIdentity, descriptive, rights, thumbnails (any combination), or minimise on its own (every EXIF, XMP, IPTC and Photoshop block and comment deleted while the encoded image, JFIF, Adobe and ICC segments and the EXIF orientation, chroma position and colour space are kept). Each is proved absent by the independent readers and by a fresh native listing; orientation, colour and the encoded image are never touched. | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":7,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":["location","captureTime","deviceIdentity","descriptive","rights","thumbnails","minimise"]}}` | **required** |
